2007_local_4.question:
An experiment is carried out to determine the molar mass of a compound by the freezing point depression method using the equation
\[
\text{MM} = 7.05 \times \frac{\text{mass solute}}{\Delta T \times \text{kg solvent}}
\]
The data below are collected:
\[
\begin{array}{ll}
\text{Mass of empty test tube} & 42.0\text{ g} \\
\text{Mass of test tube and solvent} & 73.6\text{ g} \\
\text{Mass of solute dissolved in solvent} & 2.000\text{ g} \\
\text{Freezing point of pure solvent} & 78.1\,^\circ\mathrm{C} \\
\text{Freezing point of solution} & 77.6\,^\circ\mathrm{C}
\end{array}
\]
How many significant figures can be reported for the molar mass of the solute?
